bullets.text: London Marathon 2026: How to Watch - The marathon will air in the UK on **BBC** for free.
Google Wallet Expands Passport Support - Now includes passports from **Brazil**, **Singapore**, and **Taiwan**.
Apple Wallet Enhances Digital ID - New age verification feature launched for **Apple Wallet** users.
Apple TV's Criminal Record Returns - Season 2 of the acclaimed London crime thriller is now available.
Pioneer Sphera Launches Dolby Atmos - The first aftermarket CarPlay system to support **Dolby Atmos** is now available.
Apple's New Hardware Strategy - **John Ternus** takes over as CEO, focusing on AI-powered devices.
Apple TV Executive Moves to Amazon - **Oliver Jones** leaves Apple TV to lead U.K. scripted content at Amazon.
Apple Watch Tracks Time in Daylight - New health metric automatically records exposure to sunlight.
Apple's Next iPad Naming Scheme - Speculation surrounds the naming of the upcoming **iPad** with A18 chip.
Used EVs Expected to Flood Market - An influx of used electric vehicles could significantly lower prices.
